summary.text: Sade Elhawary represents California's 57th Assembly District, which includes Exposition Park, South Los Angeles and Downtown Los Angeles.

paragraphs.text: She was born and raised in Los Angeles and worked at Community Coalition for over 12 years as a youth organizer.
Elhawary holds a bachelor's degree from UCLA and a master's from the Harvard Graduate School of Education.
